ns2:course.label: Deep Foundations
ns2:course.description: (CEE 485) Ultimate capacities and load-deflection of piles and drilled shafts subjected to compressive loads, tensile loads, and lateral loads; effects of duration of load, soil-structure interaction; two and three dimensional analysis of pile groups with closely spaced piles; effects of installation; inspection of deep foundations and full-scale field tests. Prerequisite: CEE 484.
